episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Newly out of prison, Matilda visits the rabbi to ask after her daughter, Raşel, whose fate rests with Çelebi, a nightclub manager with a vendetta.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Matilda's attempts to connect with Raşel come to naught. Selim reckons with an unwelcome visit ahead of his highly anticipated opening night.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Matilda tells Raşel about a family tragedy — but obscures a key truth. Raşel's involvement with İsmet sends Matilda over the edge.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Raşel presses Matilda for details about her father. Mordo confronts İsmet. Matilda probes Çelebi's past and uncovers a link to her own.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: A difficult choice looms for Raşel. Tensions rise between Matilda and Çelebi. Orhan's concerns grow as the political winds shift.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Selim grapples with tragic news right before a show. Orhan confronts Çelebi about his actions toward Matilda.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Çelebi reveals a shocking truth to Selim, who makes a personal sacrifice for Matilda's sake. Orhan takes on great risk to cover Mevhibe's tracks.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Raşel runs off to İsmet, who makes a surprising decision. Çelebi gains authority at The Club and sheds new light on Matilda's past with Mümtaz.

episodes.title: 9. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Kürşat finds a gap in Orhan's files. Raşel and İsmet face a crossroads on their day of marriage. Matilda is presented with a life-altering decision.

episodes.title: 10. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Kürşat closes in on Orhan, but Mevhibe intervenes. Matilda scrambles to find Raşel as violence breaks out in Istanbul, and Çelebi saves the day.

episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Growing up in the halls of Club Istanbul, Rânâ longs for the father she doesn't know. Matilda learns that the future of the club is at stake.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: The employees of the club come together to protect it — but when Raşel sees someone sabotaging their lead act, she must decide where her loyalties lie.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Raşel confronts her husband about his absence. İsmet tries to reenter his daughter's life. Çelebi makes a deal behind his partners' back.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Çelebi comes clean to Matilda about his new partner at the club. İsmet and Raşel try to find a new normal in their relationship.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: When Fikret champions a new headliner, Çelebi and Matilda fight for their own vision. Meanwhile, Raşel reveals a devastating secret.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: İsmet tries to play a bigger role in his daughter's life. As the club struggles, Matilda pays Fikret's father a visit.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Matilda makes a long-overdue apology. Raşel makes a shocking discovery. Inexperienced help at the club creates problems for Çelebi.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: As the streets fall into chaos, the club is hit with yet another unexpected obstacle. At home, Rânâ makes a surprising accusation.

episodes.title: 9. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Rânâ shares an upsetting truth with her father. Çelebi and Matilda prepare to start a bittersweet new chapter. Raşel considers snitching on a friend.

episodes.title: 10. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Raşel rushes to the hospital for an emergency. Tensions boil over in this season finale full of twists and heartache.
